logp.method_description: The distribution coefficient of the six complexes was determined using the standard shakeflask method in the octanol-water system. 0.1 M of NaCl was added into the aqueous layer to minimize the aqueous hydrolysis. Each set of data was performed in triplicates and the absorbance was recorded in Biotech Micro plate reader SYNERGY H1M. The concentration of the complexes in the octanol layer was first determined before the experiment. After 2 h of shaking at 37ºC in a BOD incubator, the concentration of complexes remaining in the octanol layer was further calculated and subtracted from the previous one which gave the concentration of the complexes in the water system. Distribution coefficient values (log Do/w) were obtained from the ratio of the complex concentration present in octanol and water.
